name: Life and Limb — if layer 4 does not apply to a land, its color change does not either
notes: Memory: project_loop_explanation_and_rejection_2026-04-08. Blood Moon makes Taiga a plain Mountain, so Life and Limb (all Forests become green Saproling creatures) no longer applies to it in layer 4, even though Life and Limb is older. Per the ability-group rule the rest of that ability must not apply to Taiga either, so it is not green and not a creature. The basic Forest is a control that Blood Moon leaves alone: green 1/1 Saproling Forest creature land.
